title: Smart Use XP
description: Makes enchanting fairer by charging exact experience points instead of full levels.
body:
# Smart Use XP

![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.1-brightgreen)
![Mod Loader](https://img.shields.io/badge/NeoForge-Compatible-orange)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue)

A Quality of Life (QoL) Minecraft mod that makes enchanting smarter, fairer, and removes the vanilla "high-level XP tax".

## 🌟 Features

In vanilla Minecraft, the experience system is flawed: dropping from level 50 to 47 costs significantly more raw experience points than dropping from level 30 to 27.

**Smart Use XP** introduces a brand new block—the **Smart Enchanting Table**—which fixes this exact issue!

- **Fair Enchanting Cost:** The table calculates the exact raw XP needed for the enchantment tier (1, 2, or 3 levels) as if you were exactly at the required level, and safely refunds the remaining experience points to the player.
- **Vanilla Feel:** Retains the classic UI and floating book animations you know and love, but works fairly behind the scenes.
- **Balanced Progression:** You no longer need to run to the enchanting table the exact moment you hit level 30 just to avoid wasting experience!
